args.sql:
WITH t AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2013-04-02 05:59' AS ts),
st AS (
  SELECT s.subject, s.id, s.ref, s.status, s.status_category
  FROM issue_state_at('apache-rave', (SELECT ts FROM t)) s
  WHERE s.in_project = 'RAVE' OR s.in_project IN (SELECT id FROM entities WHERE 1=0)
),
rel AS (
  SELECT src, dst FROM relations_at('apache-rave', (SELECT ts FROM t)) WHERE rel = 'blocks'
)
SELECT r.src AS blocked_subject, r.dst AS blocker_subject,
       a.ref AS blocked_ref, a.status AS blocked_status,
       b.ref AS blocker_ref, b.status AS blocker_status
FROM rel r
LEFT JOIN issue_state_at('apache-rave', (SELECT ts FROM t)) a ON a.subject = r.src
LEFT JOIN issue_state_at('apache-rave', (SELECT ts FROM t)) b ON b.subject = r.dst
ORDER BY r.src;
SELECT subject, verdict FROM blocked_verdicts('apache-rave', TIMESTAMP '2013-04-02 05:59') WHERE verdict = true;
